name: The palace at Ugarit
interests: control of the harbor and its dues
good relations with the Hittite court
grain reaching the city before winter
description: Officials, scribes, and a gate that decides who is worth its time. The palace does not need to be liked; it needs to be obeyed, and it knows the difference.

sources: Ugaritic palace archives and correspondence, general
provenance.notes: Palace administration at Ugarit is attested. The named officials are invented.
